about: The start stamp a panel's archive URL carries: YYYY-MM-DD:HH-MM.
notes: Wall-clock time on the panel's server, in the time zone it reported. The second argument is that zone, or null to use the machine's own.
Every case here names a zone, so the answer does not depend on where the test runs.

cases.name: a zone can push the date to the previous day
summer time is applied for the date in question
cases.why: Not a fixed offset: the same panel is +0200 in January and +0300 in July, and using the wrong one asks the archive for a programme an hour away.

cases.name: a time that is not a time is refused
cases.why: Better to fail here than to build a URL the panel answers with something unexpected. Note what is NOT refused: zero is a real instant, so a second implementation must reject only a time that is not a number at all.
